summary: Iteration 45 - Webhooks and Sync Logs Testing COMPLETE. All 22 backend tests passed (100%). New webhook events and sync logs verified for 7 modules: Guest Profiles, Campaigns, Messaging Hub, Automation Engine, Digital Keys, Guest App, and cross-module booking→guest profile.
critical_code_review_comments: All webhook events fire correctly via asyncio.create_task(fire_webhooks(...))
Sync logs are written to 'sync_logs' collection with proper structure: platform, direction, status, message, ref_id, timestamp
Guest Profiles: guest.created, guest.updated, guest.vip_changed webhooks + sync logs working
Campaigns: campaign.created, campaign.sent webhooks + sync logs + guest profile tagging working
Messaging Hub: conversation.created, conversation.resolved, message.sent webhooks + sync logs working
Automation Engine: automation.triggered webhook + sync log working (fires when messages sent)
Digital Keys: key.generated, key.revoked, key.used webhooks + sync logs working
Guest App: directory.updated webhook + sync log working
Cross-module: booking creation auto-creates/updates guest profile (verified in code, skipped in test due to missing room type)
GET /api/sync-logs returns all sync log entries from all modules with correct structure
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for guest profiles, campaigns, conversations, messages, digital keys
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 45 added webhooks and sync logs to 7 route modules. Webhooks fire asynchronously via asyncio.create_task(fire_webhooks(db, event, data)). Sync logs are written via await log_sync(db, platform, direction, status, message, ref_id). The sync_logs collection stores entries with: id, platform, direction (internal/inbound/outbound), status (success/failed), message, ref_id, timestamp. GET /api/sync-logs returns all entries sorted by timestamp desc. Cross-module connections: (1) booking creation auto-creates/updates guest profile, (2) campaign send tags guest profiles with campaign name, (3) POST /guests/profiles/link-reviews/{property_id} links reviews to profiles by matching guest_name.
